title: Diabetes technology global supply chains face mounting pressure
excerpt: GlobalData analysts Dr Andrew Thompson and Charlie Whelan will discuss key challenges impacting the diabetes technology supply chain in a webinar on 18 Augus...
content_html:
Ross Law

Mon, August 10, 2026 at 4:16 AM PDT 1 min read

Throughout 2026, tariffs, inflation, and shifting geopolitical dynamics have added additional pressure to medtech supply chains, with the diabetes technology supply chain being no exception.

For diabetes technology, these factors are reshaping where devices are made, how they're priced, and ultimately, which products reach patients. On 18 August, GlobalData Healthcare analysts Dr Andrew Thompson, director of therapy research and analysis, medical devices, and Charlie Whelan, senior director of consulting, medical devices, will host a webinar assessing the impact these challenges.

During the "Lifting the Lid on the Diabetes Tech Supply Chain" webinar, Thompson and Whelan will draw on revenue and volume data across the diabetes device market to show how macroeconomic forces translate into real commercial and patient-level outcomes.

Topics under assessment will include how globalised manufacturing across the diabetes device market creates exposure to tariff and inflation risk, where revenue and volume flows sit today, and the relationship between gate pricing and macroeconomics, with Thompson and Whelan assessing what these factors mean for manufacturers, payers, and patients as geopolitical uncertainty continues.

Keen to learn more about how market challenges are impacting pricing and production dynamics in the diabetes technology supply chain?

Register for our webinar, taking place 18 August at 3:00pm BST, at the link below:

https://globaldata.zoom.us/webinar/register/6917834313659/WN_rnGlEFywRzqHC1q2Av9jnw

content_html_zh:
罗斯·劳

太平洋夏令时间 2026 年 8 月 10 日星期一凌晨 4:16 阅读时间 1 分钟

整个 2026 年，关税、通货膨胀和不断变化的地缘政治动态给医疗技术供应链带来了额外的压力，糖尿病技术供应链也不例外。

对于糖尿病技术而言，这些因素正在重塑设备的制造地点、定价方式以及最终向患者提供的产品。 8 月 18 日，GlobalData Healthcare 分析师、医疗设备治疗研究和分析总监 Andrew Thompson 博士以及医疗设备咨询高级总监 Charlie Whelan 将举办一场网络研讨会，评估这些挑战的影响。

在“揭开糖尿病技术供应链的盖子”网络研讨会期间，Thompson 和 Whelan 将利用整个糖尿病设备市场的收入和数量数据来展示宏观经济力量如何转化为真正的商业和患者层面的结果。

评估的主题将包括糖尿病器械市场的全球化制造如何造成关税和通胀风险、当前收入和销量的情况，以及门禁定价和宏观经济之间的关系，汤普森和惠兰将评估随着地缘政治不确定性的持续，这些因素对制造商、付款人和患者意味着什么。

渴望更多地了解市场挑战如何影响糖尿病技术供应链的定价和生产动态？

https://globaldata.zoom.us/webinar/register/6917834313659/WN_rnGlEFywRzqHC1q2Av9jnw
